immutable_machinery.why: LIVE/DEAD/UNKNOWN algebra; CANNOT_CHECK cannot become success

immutable_machinery.why: Meet-only composition; commit coordinate never minted by internal operators

immutable_machinery.name: scope/epoch algebra
immutable_machinery.why: Intersection under composition; unknown chronology is unsatisfied

immutable_machinery.name: type registry extensibility without warrant forks
immutable_machinery.why: New atom/relation types register as data

immutable_machinery.name: KnowledgeSpace object schema
immutable_machinery.why: One atom/hyperedge model; structural edits return a new space

immutable_machinery.name: impact cone + reopening
immutable_machinery.why: Exact dependents reopen; alternate support preserved

immutable_machinery.name: operator candidate warrant rule
immutable_machinery.why: STATISTICAL/NEURAL outputs enter UNKNOWN; score is outside the lattice

immutable_machinery.name: learner cannot admit
immutable_machinery.why: Feedback alone never mints warrant unless a registered FeedbackContract says so

immutable_machinery.name: hard-gate contract + permits_closure
immutable_machinery.why: No score; CANNOT_CHECK ≠ FAIL; contract frozen by round index

immutable_machinery.name: commit_external_action sequence
immutable_machinery.why: Intent → warrant → gate → injected authority → execute → receipt. No skip path in production.

immutable_machinery.name: host-injected CommitAuthority
immutable_machinery.why: Runtime never holds an object that can grant commit

immutable_machinery.name: event reducer + replay
immutable_machinery.why: State is a function of events; executable backends rebound by host, never deserialized

immutable_machinery.name: physical ledger
immutable_machinery.why: Crash-atomic hash chain. Bytes are not warrant.

immutable_machinery.name: solve commitment gate
immutable_machinery.why: CANNOT_CHECK propagates; solver does not write the store

mutable_machine_state.name: host operator implementations
mutable_machine_state.notes: Code is host-supplied and rebound after replay; not deserialized from the log

mutable_machine_state.name: injected commit authority handle
mutable_machine_state.notes: Held privately; never exposed to operators. Identity of the authority is host state, not field state.
